blend: NORMAL; separate additive procedural muzzle / arrival / death cues

pivot.space: normalized top-left; candidate visual rotating-base anchor, not collision

textureBudget: 512x341 per shared Phaser texture; WebP preserves 1536x1024 master dimensions

animation.shot: Unit.shotAt; muzzle placed at visual barrel end
animation.spawn: .32s procedural cue starting at first observed living summon
animation.despawn: .3s procedural cue only after observed hp transition; no gameplay callbacks
animation.lowEffects: solid body remains; ornamental cues omitted

source.method: Original friendly navy/ivory/gold/cyan twin cannon. Generated RGBA master unchanged; WebP encoding at same size. Runtime scales with original alpha.

limits: First representative only. Drone / soldiers / decoy textures are not complete. Existing clones retain the source character sprite.
